subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing satire and its use to critique social or political issues
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a satirical exaggeration to the real-world issue it targets
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a satirical passage to the real issue it's critiquing
exercise.abstract: Student explains what real-world issue a given satirical passage critiques and how the exaggeration makes the point

misconception_flags: interprets satirical exaggeration literally rather than recognizing the underlying critique

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
